hook_en: Say it out loud today: I love You, Lord. 🙏
reflect_en: Rock, fortress, deliverer, shield, stronghold. David runs out of words for how safe God makes him. Before you ask Him for anything today, simply tell Him you love Him.
q_en: Which of these names of God do you need most right now?
x_en: I love You, O LORD, my strength. The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
tiktok: Rock. Fortress. Deliverer. Shield. 🙏 Psalm 18:1–2 — which one do you need today?
yt_title: The LORD Is My Rock and My Fortress | Psalm 18:1–2 #Shorts
yt_line: Tell Him you love Him today.
li_open: Every leader needs a place to stand.
li_quote: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
li_body: David led armies and a nation, yet his first words here are "I love You." Strong leadership grows out of a secure foundation, and so does a church that prays for its people.
reflect_es: Roca, castillo, libertador, escudo, refugio. David no encuentra suficientes palabras para describir cuán seguro está en Dios. Antes de pedirle algo hoy, simplemente dile que lo amas.
q_es: ¿Cuál de estos nombres de Dios necesitas más hoy?
x_es: Amarte he, oh Jehová, fortaleza mía. Jehová, roca mía y castillo mío, y mi libertador
